snippet.title: The Wake Event - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
You wake alone aboard a station that was never supposed to be empty.

Restore failing systems. Navigate interconnected terminals. Piece together what happened to the crew—and determine why the station is still watching you.

The Wake Event is a first-person sci-fi psychological horror game where observation goes both ways.

Download the demo & wishlist today! 👁️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4757720/The_Wake_Event/
